summary: Urn with 4 balls each independently black/white w.p. 1/2, draws with replacement: find distribution of first black draw time given 3 black balls (geometric), posterior probability of 3 black given X1=0,X2=1 via Bayes, and show via law of large numbers that P(|S_n - k/4|<ε) → P(Y=k) = C(4,k)2^-4.
